title: Update on projects - Community Film, New-Futures and Kabocha
body:
Hi all. Been a while. Been busy in Kusama/Polkadot - mostly figuring out what is broken and what is fixable. Good news is, we've learned all the hardest lessons here in Edgeware/Kabocha ahead of the big boys. Oh and I'm currently banned from the Polkadot forum. 

Anyways. Updates on two things:

1. **Community film **


This has been a rollercoaster - for all sorts of reasons.

- We set out to make a 'community film' - and then the founding team left.
- We then switched gears to make it with the people left. Then they left.
- So we just decided to make something that we liked and made us laugh and reflected the experience of actually contributing in crypto. 
- Here it is - [check the link ](https://app.frame.io/reviews/c512417f-c797-41fb-b495-e6dd902317a3/a69b5d70-88e6-4685-982e-fc4a481e3f7c)
- It still needs some tweaking, and the voiceover will change probably, but it's a perfect scene setter for what comes next.
- We're developing NGU (Number Go Up), a comedy feature film about crypto, Web3 and how skewed incentives make people go weeeird. 
- In a former life I developed some pretty big shows - including [You, Me and the Apocalypse](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/You,_Me_and_the_Apocalypse) (Sky / NBC comedy series).
- Our network includes people who put together the financing / licensing deal for [The Inbetweeners Movie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Inbetweeners_Movie) - the most successful Briitsh comedy of all time. 
- It made $88m on a budget of £3.5m 
- We're gonna have a slate of movies - yeah, MOVIES that touch of subjects related to themes of system change (aka what the crypto industry claims to want.
- We're gonna use chain funding, substrate and tools / services as our foundation to unpick the fucked up issues with film financing, accounting and credits - see [Hollywood Accounting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollywood_accounting). 
- We're going to use Edgeware and Kabocha and RMRK's fancy NFTs and probably other parts of Kusama/Polkadot.
